absence.description:
Set by a receipt lookup or `ResolveAction` that has no receipt to act
on: it found no row, or a `no_longer_held` closure.

closed.description:
Set by a receipt lookup or `ResolveAction` when the executor holds a
closure for the action, recorded now or earlier: no execute request
for it can run any more. Without it an absence proves nothing about an
execute request still on its way.

epoch.description:
The container executor's receipt-store epoch, set on every answer that
read or wrote the receipt store (execute, lookup, verify, resolve). It
changes whenever the store is reopened, so a store lost and recreated,
or restored from an older copy, never answers under the epoch core
dispatched under: core then holds every job it dispatched under the
earlier epoch for an operator instead of accepting a `never_recorded`
closure for it.

resolution_refusal.description:
Set by `ResolveAction` when a terminal receipt's recorded outcome
contradicts the declaration; nothing changed.

ContainerHealthCohort.description: Plain selected observations. Deserialization restores no Engine or poll lease.

ContainerSnapshot.description:
Selected inspection evidence. Environment variables, labels and host paths
never enter a plan. The full ID, image and start timestamp identify an instance.

DeclaredOutcome.description:
What the administrator declares about the job. Only `AcceptedDivergence`
rests on the operator's word; the other two are checked against evidence.

oneOf.description: The intended end state is present on every target.
Nothing took effect: every target still equals the plan's `expected`.
The present state differs from both before and intended; accepted.

DiscoveryCohort.description: Selected past facts, never file/Engine ownership or execution permission.

hidden_projects.description:
Distinct Compose projects that Engine containers outside `members`
(truncated or omitted) declare in their list labels: a stack named by
one has an unread member, and each takes part in the overlap checks.

omitted.description: Inspected containers left out of `members`, with their reason.

unattributed.description:
Listed containers whose Compose project could not be established: list
labels that do not decode, or beyond the hidden-project bounds.

oneOf.description:
The container executor refused an execute request for an action it
holds no receipt for, because the plan expires at or below its prune
watermark: a receipt for it may have been pruned, so the executor can
no longer tell whether the action already ran. Never retried as an
effect. Fresh plans meet it only after the clock stepped back by more
than the receipt retention period, until the clock catches up.

Stack aggregate only: every sent member is verified and every other
member is provably unsent. Terminal; never reported as success.

MountHelperIdentity.description:
Authenticated receipt facts only. Construction of their genuine process owner
and confirmation that no descendant/helper can still run belong to supervision.

ReceiptAbsence.description:
What the executor can say about an action it holds no receipt for. It is
decided from the receipt store's prune watermark, the greatest plan expiry
among every receipt it ever pruned, never from the clock.

oneOf.description:
The plan expires after the watermark, so no receipt for it was ever
pruned: none was ever written, and since a durable Prepared row precedes
every Engine call, nothing was sent.

A receipt for the plan may have existed and been pruned, so absence
proves nothing: the action may have run.

ResolveKind.description: Which executor table holds the action: one container or a whole stack.

ResolveReceipt.description:
The executor's confirmation that its row is `resolved` and its unique-index
slot is free. Returned for the original request and for every repeat.

ResolveRefusal.description:
The executor's refusal to resolve a terminal receipt with a declaration
its recorded outcome contradicts. Nothing changed; `allowed` lists what it
would accept.

StackDeclaration.description: Plain input values, not retained evidence or a wire admission decoder.

StackFileStatus.description: Diagnostic facts only. No variant makes stack actions executable.

StackOmissionReason.description: Why one inspected Engine container is not among the members.

oneOf.description: Its identity-relevant facts differed between the two inspections.
A mount type, label set or name this reader does not model.

StackOmittedContainer.description:
An Engine container left out of the read with its reason. `project` is the
Compose project its label names, when that label alone is well formed.

StackReceipt.description:
`state` is always the aggregate of `members`, which lists exactly the
plan's targets. A member that was never sent is `precondition_changed`.

StackSnapshot.description: Every ordinary (non one-off) member, stopped or running, sorted by ID.

StorageFstabEntry.description:
Only identity/target fields leave the protected reader. Fstab options may
contain credentials and are never copied into RPC, plans or HTTP responses.

StorageMountCatalog.description: Protected configuration choices, independent of live readiness or authority.

StorageMountInspection.description:
A protected reader's past facts. Empty-target/complete-consumer proofs are opaque
retained owners held by the executor, and cannot be reconstructed from this DTO.

TargetPreparationPlan.description:
This root-executor contract preserves the original operator receipt bytes.
It does not itself carry human authority; API authority is the v2 wrapper.
